## Slack Daily Summary — Real Integration

Real-Slack variant of workflow #3. Same webhook path (`slack-daily-summary`) and same callback contract — operators must DEACTIVATE the mock workflow before activating this one.

Credential setup:
1. api.slack.com → create app with Bot Token Scopes `channels:history`, `channels:read`.
2. n8n → Credentials → New → "Slack API" → paste Bot Token.
3. Open the `Slack: Get Messages` node and pick the credential.
4. Set agent config.channel to a real channel ID (e.g. C01234ABCDE).

Fallback: if the Slack node fails (bad credential, bad channel, network) or returns 0 messages, the Summarize node falls back to the same mock messages used by `slack-daily-summary.json`. This means the demo never breaks just because the bot token is missing — operators can flip between mock and real with no schema changes.
